topic: Workstream A templates: reduce/optimize system-spec-kit doc templates (tasks+checklist merge, 033-leftover dedup, _memory.continuity 5x dup, HTML comment leakage, small-model legibility, acceptance-criteria single-sourcing)

focus: angle (a): unified tasks+checklist design, deriveStatus/detectLevel/manifest/PRIORITY_TAGS migration surface
noveltyJustification: First evidence pass: established that deriveStatus ignores tasks checkboxes when checklist exists, detectLevel keys on checklist file presence, and manifest models checklist as L2+ addon - all load-bearing for the merge directive.
ruledOut: naive merge without legacy deriveStatus read-path

focus: angle (b) part 1: renderer IF-gate mechanics, ADR-004 byte-identical gate as vitest snapshots, checklist duplication measured 585->80 unique lines
noveltyJustification: Measured the actual triple-copy size (505 dup lines, L3=L3+ minus 5 lines) and located the concrete gate suite (scaffold-golden-snapshots) - both were previously dispatch-level claims only.
ruledOut: cross-file template includes/partials (renderer lacks the feature)

focus: angle (c): _memory.continuity duplication measured (8 templates, L2 packet ~227 lines); resume ladder reads impl-summary only; FRONTMATTER_MEMORY_BLOCK + SESSION_LINEAGE are live consumers of the copies
noveltyJustification: Verified the dispatch claim at implementation level AND discovered two validator consumers that make a naive copy-drop fail validate.sh --strict - changing the recommendation from 'drop 4' to 'validator-coordinated drop'.
ruledOut: dropping continuity copies with zero code changes (FRONTMATTER_MEMORY_BLOCK regression)

focus: angle (d): instructional HTML comment leakage measured ~15.5% of L2 rendered doc bytes (8.3KB/packet); impl-summary worst at 43.6%; zero downstream consumers
noveltyJustification: Converted a qualitative dispatch angle into per-template byte measurements and confirmed via negative grep that no validator consumes the leaked prose - making out-of-band relocation safe.

focus: angle (e): external evidence - instruction stacking collapse, context-length degradation, lost-in-the-middle, spec-kit ~230-line tasks template, 1-2 page ADR norm; draft per-doc byte budgets
noveltyJustification: External controlled studies reframe byte reduction as an agent-quality lever (contradicting 033's maintainability-only framing) and provide concrete budget targets plus ordering guidance.

focus: angle (f): AC_COVERAGE reads definition from spec.md + evidence matrix from checklist.md; other 3 restatements decorative; recommendation = single-source definition, one derived matrix in merged doc
noveltyJustification: Decomposed the '5x restatement' into 2 machine-consumed sites + 3 decorative ones and found the advisory severity makes merge retargeting low-regression-risk.

focus: versioned-change surface map: content-router (docPath,anchorId) defaults, single golden snapshot file, continuity-freshness keys on impl-summary only; consolidated migration table
noveltyJustification: Produced the exact per-change co-update matrix including which changes need empty-diff vs re-baseline, and confirmed anchor routing is untouched by the merge.

focus: value x risk ranking R1-R6 + shipped-packet regression ledger + sequencing (dedup first, merge third, validator-first continuity, research taxonomy deferred)
noveltyJustification: Analytical consolidation converting six findings sets into an ordered, regression-flagged execution plan; no new external evidence.

focus: re-verification: comment leakage and _memory duplication proven against committed golden snapshot baseline (11 SELF-CHECK blocks, 22 packet_pointer copies); residual save-pipeline UNKNOWN carried explicitly
noveltyJustification: Upgraded two simulation-derived findings to baseline-proven status, closing the main methodological risk in the evidence chain.

focus: final broadening: merged-doc ordering discipline beats file split; handover.md is a freshness competitor not a duplicate (non-merge guard); plan.md gate line consumer-free
noveltyJustification: Added one guard finding (handover non-merge) that prevents over-extension of the reduction scope, and confirmed the last unchecked prose line is consumer-free.
